scope: Prospective paper research only; no trading or live-admission authority.

specification.weather_scale_fit: All-event categorical Brier, including tail winners, on the original fixed K grid.
specification.selection: Earliest qualifying complete lead>=1 book per city/target; rank by rounded-fee net edge.

evidence.required_metadata: All paginated scheduled-run listings covering the capture window, every listed original attempt, and all artifact-list pages for each original run; preserve exact raw bytes and headers/receipts, including failed runs and missing/expired artifacts.
evidence.artifact_publication_bound: max(artifact.created_at, artifact.updated_at, original_attempt.updated_at); original attempt must be terminal. Bound and run creation must be on the artifact capture UTC date, and bound must precede every selected target date at 00:00 UTC.
evidence.duplicate_rule: Same-date valid candidate artifacts must agree exactly in latest_capture, required_capture_date, capture_sha256, policy hashes, specification and every family selected list. Keep all evidence, count earliest publication bound then lowest run id once. Any conflicting candidate artifact or earlier possibly-produced but unavailable decision makes that date unknown. Never replace an unknown decision with a later successful attempt.
evidence.guard_skip_rule: An original attempt with no candidate artifact can be excluded as a harmless duplicate only when preserved jobs/step evidence proves recovery_shadow was skipped because the daily capture guard already succeeded and a complete same-date candidate artifact exists. Other missing candidate artifacts remain unknown.
evidence.input_linkage: Archive exact captured input bytes matching capture_sha256, decision ZIP and GitHub digest when supplied, member digest, raw run/attempt/artifact metadata and retrieval receipts; missing or conflicting linkage prevents a complete verdict.
evidence.metadata_consistency: Require repository, workflow, run/attempt identity and artifact bindings to agree. Treat created/start/update timestamps as separately named provider fields; no equality of listing created_at and attempt created_at is presumed. Preserve discrepancies; all evidence must still unambiguously satisfy the same-day publication and before-target bounds.
evidence.policy_change: Any changed decision-policy hash makes the original study incomplete; retain all old artifacts and register a new future study without pooling or moving these dates.

settlement.unresolved_at_cutoff: inconclusive; retain full cost and show worst-case exposure separately, never drop the selection
settlement.conflicting_outcomes: inconclusive; preserve all versions, never choose the profitable one
settlement.post_cutoff_updates: retain as labeled sensitivity only; cannot rescue or replace the fixed-cutoff primary result

accounting.stress: Keep saved ticker and side; increase paid price by 0.01, resize with unchanged size_order inside 15 including recalculated rounded fee. Any unpriceable primary stress order prevents a passing stress criterion.

inference.group: all primary selections sharing target_date, across all cities
inference.calendar_grid: Inclusive minimum through maximum target_date of all saved primary selections, defined without outcomes; zero groups only on internal calendar dates without selections; unresolved selections still define endpoints.
inference.bootstrap: circular stationary bootstrap of joint (daily net, daily fee-inclusive cost) pairs
inference.draw_algorithm: Use Python random.Random(seed). Each replicate starts with randrange(N); for each remaining observation call random(): if less than 1/7 restart at randrange(N), otherwise advance index modulo N. Stop after N observations. Retain every replicate.
inference.quantiles: Sort all 20000 ROI draws; central 95% endpoints are zero-based indices floor(20000*0.025)=500 and floor(20000*0.975)=19500. Report zero-cost draw count.
inference.assumptions: Approximate inference under weak dependence and stationarity; no finite-sample coverage guarantee, no correction for unseen loss states or regime change.

final_criteria.minimum_information_note: Conservative administrative minima, not a power calculation or statistical guarantee. Fewer than two negative groups is insufficient tail evidence, even if all observed outcomes win.
final_criteria.drawdown_definition: Aggregate net by target date on the complete calendar grid; start cumulative and peak at zero, update peak=max(peak,cumulative), and report max(peak-cumulative). This is observed research risk compatibility, not account-loss protection or replay of the running pilot guard.

verdicts.before_cutoff: pending; no final success, even if interim metrics pass

source_study_separation: Does not change the September 25 source-study protocol, October 10 freeze, reserved Oct10-23 embargo or Oct24 release gate. Source-study reserved observations are never inputs to this evaluation.
